WITH InternalMax AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal_value
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
ExternalMax AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external_value
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_value, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(em.max_external_value, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_value - em.max_external_value, 2) AS difference
FROM collateral_asset ca
INNER JOIN InternalMax im ON ca.collateral_id = im.collateral_id
INNER JOIN ExternalMax em ON ca.collateral_id = em.collateral_id
WHERE im.max_internal_value > em.max_external_value
ORDER BY difference DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT 
        cv.collateral_id,
        cv.valuation_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cv.collateral_id ORDER BY cv.valued_on DESC) as rn
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
),
effective_pledges AS (
    SELECT 
        cl.collateral_id,
        SUM(cl.pledged_amount) as total_pledged_amount
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
)
SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    lv.valuation_amount,
    ep.total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(ep.total_pledged_amount - lv.valuation_amount, 2) as coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN latest_valuation lv ON ca.collateral_id = lv.collateral_id AND lv.rn = 1
JOIN effective_pledges ep ON ca.collateral_id = ep.collateral_id
WHERE lv.valuation_amount < ep.total_pledged_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    -- 计算每个借款人（保证人）自身的借款合同金额合计
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_borrowed_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_commitments AS (
    -- 计算每个保证人对外提供的有效保证承诺金额合计
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(bl.total_borrowed_amount, 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(gc.total_guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitments gc
JOIN borrower_loans bl ON gc.guarantor_party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.total_guaranteed_amount > bl.total_borrowed_amount
ORDER BY gc.total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
HAVING
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.is_public_official = 1
    AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    egt.name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i
    ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egt
    ON eg.group_type = egt.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name,
    egt.name_zh
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY
    member_count DESC;

SELECT
    egm.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY group_count DESC, egm.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS relation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM party p
INNER JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
INNER JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COALESCE(src_loan.cnt, 0) AS source_loan_count,
    COALESCE(tgt_loan.cnt, 0) AS target_loan_count
FROM
    party_relation pr
JOIN
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            borrower_party_id,
            COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM
            credit_agreement ca
        WHERE
            ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
        GROUP BY
            borrower_party_id
    ) src_loan ON pr.source_party_id = src_loan.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            borrower_party_id,
            COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM
            credit_agreement ca
        WHERE
            ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
        GROUP BY
            borrower_party_id
    ) tgt_loan ON pr.target_party_id = tgt_loan.borrower_party_id
WHERE
    rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
    AND src_loan.cnt IS NOT NULL
    AND tgt_loan.cnt IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    (COALESCE(src_loan.cnt, 0) + COALESCE(tgt_loan.cnt, 0)) DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ca.collateral_type
FROM
    collateral_asset ca
WHERE
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM collateral_link cl
        WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
          AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    )
ORDER BY
    ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH guarantor_effective_guarantee AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_effective_guarantee
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 0) AS total_loan_exposure
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs 
        ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id 
        AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    geg.total_effective_guarantee,
    COALESCE(ble.total_loan_exposure, 0) AS own_loan_exposure,
    ROUND(geg.total_effective_guarantee - COALESCE(ble.total_loan_exposure, 0), 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM guarantor_effective_guarantee geg
JOIN party p ON geg.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_loan_exposure ble ON geg.guarantor_party_id = ble.borrower_party_id
WHERE geg.total_effective_guarantee > COALESCE(ble.total_loan_exposure, 0)
ORDER BY excess_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount AS guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status AS guarantee_status
FROM
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN
    party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN
    secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
    AND ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
GROUP BY
    gc.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    gc.guaranteed_amount,
    gc.status
ORDER BY
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    gc.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
  AND phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY
    wp.product_name ASC,
    overdue_principal_total DESC

SELECT
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 2) AS total_secured_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY total_secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM
    exposure_group_member egm
JOIN
    exposure_group eg ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ph.carrying_amount - ph.fair_value), 2) AS inverted_amount_sum,
    COUNT(ph.holding_id) AS inverted_holding_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot ph
JOIN wealth_product p ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ph.carrying_amount > ph.fair_value
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(ph.carrying_amount - ph.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY inverted_amount_sum DESC, p.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    COALESCE(loan_overdue.total_overdue_principal, 0) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.borrower_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        SUM(overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY loan_id
) loan_overdue ON ld.loan_id = loan_overdue.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND COALESCE(loan_overdue.total_overdue_principal, 0) > 0
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_ratio_count
FROM
    collateral_link cl
WHERE
    cl.lien_priority = 1
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY
    high_ratio_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY
    fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 4) AS asset_liability_ratio
FROM
    financial_snapshot fs
JOIN
    institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE
    fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY
    asset_liability_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(c.tier1_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM
    capital_snapshot c
JOIN
    institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND c.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY
    core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE
    fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND fs.total_assets != 0
ORDER BY
    net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

WITH inst_fin AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs
        ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
),
total_rev AS (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_annual_revenue
    FROM inst_fin
)
SELECT
    inst_fin.institution_name,
    ROUND(inst_fin.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(inst_fin.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_annual_revenue, 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM inst_fin
CROSS JOIN total_rev
WHERE inst_fin.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_annual_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ma.originator_institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_rating_count
FROM managed_asset ma
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
ORDER BY inconsistent_rating_count DESC;

SELECT
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY
    ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY
    total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS certificate_count
FROM
    term_deposit td
JOIN
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    td.annual_interest_rate > 3.0
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    certificate_count DESC;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS cnt
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
  AND td.maturity_on < '2026-07-30'
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    cnt DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND((SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets) * 100, 2) AS under_provision_ratio_pct
FROM
    provision_snapshot ps
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE
    ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    AND fs.net_assets > 0
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    fs.net_assets
HAVING
    SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY
    under_provision_ratio_pct DESC,
    i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE
    cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    AND rc.classification_basis = '人工认定'
GROUP BY
    cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC,
    cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

WITH bad_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ls.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
        SUM(ls.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM delinquency_snapshot ls
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ls.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN risk_classification rc ON ls.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
    WHERE ls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ls.principal_overdue_days >= 90
      AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        fs.party_id,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot fs
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND fs.source_kind = 'AUDITED'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        bls.institution_id,
        bls.bad_loan_count,
        bls.total_overdue_principal,
        ir.annual_revenue,
        ROUND(bls.total_overdue_principal * 1.0 / ir.annual_revenue, 6) AS overdue_ratio
    FROM bad_loan_stats bls
    LEFT JOIN institution_revenue ir ON ir.party_id = 'PTY-' || bls.institution_id
    WHERE ir.annual_revenue > 0
)
SELECT
    institution_id,
    bad_loan_count,
    total_overdue_principal
FROM combined
WHERE overdue_ratio > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS principal_balance_sum,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT agreement_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_ratio DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY instruction_count DESC, pi.payment_mode ASC;

WITH institution_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        COUNT(r.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
        SUM(r.amount_value) AS abnormal_amount,
        cs.net_capital,
        fs.total_assets
    FROM institution i
    LEFT JOIN prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 r
        ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
        AND r.exception_flag = 1
    LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs
        ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
        AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs
        ON 'PTY-' || i.institution_id = fs.party_id
        AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    abnormal_record_count,
    abnormal_amount,
    net_capital,
    total_assets,
    ROUND(abnormal_amount * 1.0 / net_capital * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital_pct
FROM institution_metrics
WHERE abnormal_record_count >= 8
ORDER BY ratio_to_net_capital_pct DESC;

WITH overdue_regulatory AS (
    SELECT 
        r.institution_id,
        COUNT(r.record_id) AS overdue_record_count,
        ROUND(AVG(r.amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
    JOIN regulatory_event_catalog c ON r.event_code = c.event_code
    WHERE c.event_name_zh LIKE '%逾期%' 
       OR c.event_code LIKE '%OVERDUE%'
       AND r.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(r.record_id) >= 25
),
provision_shortfall AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.loan_id) AS shortfall_loan_count,
        ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS shortfall_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot p
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    o.overdue_record_count,
    o.avg_amount,
    COALESCE(ps.shortfall_loan_count, 0) AS shortfall_loan_count,
    COALESCE(ps.shortfall_amount, 0.00) AS shortfall_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN overdue_regulatory o ON i.institution_id = o.institution_id
LEFT JOIN provision_shortfall ps ON i.institution_id = ps.institution_id
ORDER BY ps.shortfall_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN g.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN g.ratio_value END), 4) AS avg_abnormal_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 g ON i.institution_id = g.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY abnormal_amount_sum DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE
    pr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY
    target_party_count DESC,
    relation_type_count DESC,
    p.display_name ASC;

WITH card_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_count
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
risk_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        COUNT(record_id) AS valid_risk_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END) AS risk_exception_amount
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(record_id) >= 43
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.valid_card_count,
    cs.cardholder_count,
    ROUND(rs.risk_exception_amount, 2) AS risk_exception_amount,
    rs.valid_risk_count
FROM risk_stats rs
JOIN institution i ON rs.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN card_stats cs ON rs.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY rs.risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(vr.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(vr.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM institution i
JOIN wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN ai_system_record_v3 vr ON i.institution_id = vr.institution_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND vr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(vr.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cp.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS custody_active_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.exception_flag = 1 THEN cp.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS custody_exception_amount
FROM institution inst
LEFT JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.originator_institution_id = inst.institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 cp ON cp.institution_id = inst.institution_id
GROUP BY inst.institution_id, inst.institution_name
HAVING custody_active_count >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, inst.institution_name ASC;
